# NTU Intercept

NTU Intercept is a free-to-access, browser-based 3D Cold War naval and joint-air combat simulation.

Live demo: https://cwi.kisara.info/
Source and README: https://github.com/Sekai6/game-coldwar-intercept
Documentation wiki: https://github.com/Sekai6/game-coldwar-intercept/wiki
V1.21 release: https://github.com/Sekai6/game-coldwar-intercept/releases/tag/v1.21.0

## What the project models

- Probabilistic radar detection, radar horizon, measurement error, track quality, uncertainty and aging.
- Era-aware tactical datalinks including Link 11, airborne early warning and platform-local tactical pictures.
- Aircraft interception, anti-ship strikes, shipboard air defense and multi-stage missile guidance.
- Electronic warfare, ECM, chaff, flares, seeker competition and burn-through behavior.
- Physical shipboard launch ownership: engagement queue, fire-control authorization, ammunition, launcher animation and missile separation.
- Detailed after-action review, telemetry and Tacview ACMI export for observation and data analysis.

## V1.21 scenario

“Full-Spectrum Blackout: Polar Night Disconnection” is a 15–18 minute Norwegian Sea scenario. Extreme space weather gradually degrades communications rather than deleting the tactical picture. Ships, AEW aircraft and fighters can hold conflicting information, execute lost-communications doctrine and progressively reconcile tracks during intermittent recovery windows.

## Important scope note

Real platform and weapon names establish historical context. Performance values are game-scaled and are not statements of real-world capability. The project is not intended for operational training or engineering use. It is licensed under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0.
